tokyo-kanto-rides-izu-skyline-and-jogasa.story: Scenery first, traffic last, with checkpoints that make sense on a bike. A 336 km loop that starts and ends near Yashio, about 7 h of riding. On the way it passes Kumagaya, near Itsukaichi and Kawasaki. The climbs: near Fujisawa, near Kisarazu and Scenic stretch near Honchō. Long stretches are under trees.

sections.advice: Treat Food stop near Itsukaichi → Photo stop near Fujisawa as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.
Photo stop near Fujisawa → Near Kawasaki is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

Use High point near Kisarazu → Scenic stretch near Honchō as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 67 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Moselle Wine Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 35 km this is Moselle Wine Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-watchtower-wp-1-65-neuss-reckberg.story: A 303 km round trip from Höhr-Grenzhausen - roughly 5 h 13 in the saddle. The stops in between: Limes section between watchtowers WP 1/2 a, Kottenforst Süd | Oben der Krayermaar, Köln-Deutz and Neuss-Reckberg | Kleinkastell. The line favours views over speed.
